positions.title: Software Dev Engineer II
positions.description:
Yahoo Platforms Engineering (YPE) aims to deliver modern, scalable, and secure platforms, intent on creating top tier engineering experiences and enabling our partners to deliver best-in-class products and solutions to our customers. And, create world class engineering experiences that unlock Yahoo innovation, growth, and profitability.

I focused primarily on an internal website in YPE that housed data aggregations / alerts / analytics that are critical for business reviews, cloud development, and AI usage. The majority of the work involved designing REST APIs and AWS infrastructure, integrated with ETL jobs and a PostgreSQL database. I built building features across governance, cost, utilization, and security. Most notably, I created the ingestion workflows and backend APIs for Yahoo's first AI usage and cost reports, and I designed the cloud infrastructure that would serve as the new standard for monitoring and displaying GCP cloud security alerts in near real-time.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Contributed to building out and open sourcing an Android privacy preserving library as part of the Provable Privacy Team. My engineering work involved designing and implementing new policy features, data structures, and domain-specific languages (DSLs) to express and verify policy compliance. A key goal of this team is to enable both Googlers and external developers to quickly develop new AI-based features while automating the enforcement of privacy of user data.

positions.description:
I worked on the Identity Risk team, specializing in risk mitigation. We worked with ML, Data Science, and Product Management teams to deliver features/products that improve the contribute to the safety of customer accounts.
I have fronted cross team efforts to create/enhance security and anti-automation features on different authentication pages and contributed to real time generation of features used for spam and account compromise detection. I was also a bar raiser for code reviews for an internal service used by the Buyer Risk Prevention org.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
positions.description: For summer 2017, I worked as a Software Development Engineer Intern for Amazon on the Transaction Risk Management Systems team. I collaborated with teammates to design, implement, and fully test my intern project. The project was based on implementing data collection and creating a real-time dashboard for business metrics related to Identity Risk. I learned/used many AWS tools and learned about concepts (like dependency injection, factory pattern, modularity, etc.) related to writing good, testable code.

projects.title: Predicting View Counts of Trending YouTube Videos
projects.description: Various attributes of videos were used to create a logistic regression model to predict if a video would be within a certain view range for YouTube videos. Attributes like the number of likes or comment count are simple to plug into the model and learn a weighted vector, but text attributes required more processing. These text attributes required creating a corpus with a set of test data and using those word frequencies to generalize. The end result was an ICML style paper that concluded the findings and described the project in detail.

projects.title: Budget Application
projects.description:
This project allows users to track their spending on various categories in their budgets. The total expenditures of the user is always displayed to show how much money is currently being used from the budget, and spending distribution can be viewed as a table. A graph is used to better display one's budget and the proportions being spent in each category.

This application was created for the purposes of learning and practicing web development, under the guidance of John Cha, an experienced software engineer. The project used the Spring MVC framework, and is a largely Java and Javascript based. Spring Security was used to differentiate between users and admins. User data as well as data for budgets was stored with queries to MySQL by using JDBC. Lastly, configuration with Microsoft Outlook was necessary in order to allow for email sending in the case of forgotten passwords.
